variant: both-via-gateway-temp0: GPT-5.4-mini at temperature 0, and Vercel's charge recorded for both models; declared and frozen on 2026-09-29 (UTC) before any test call
instruction: Which banking customer-support intent does this customer message express? Choose the single best label.
order: alternating per example: even index Jev first, odd index LLM first

catalog_price_per_million.note: billed through Vercel AI Gateway at promotional $0 until 2026-09-25; the gateway also reports marketCost per call

llm.system: You classify customer messages sent to a bank's support team. Pick exactly one intent label from the allowed values. Reply with JSON only.

price_per_million.source: https://developers.openai.com/api/docs/models/gpt-5.4-mini (confirmed in docs/research/SOURCE_REFRESH_2026-09-24.md; Vercel AI Gateway lists the same price)
price_per_million.note: prompts are ~490-545 tokens, below the 1,024-token prompt-caching floor, so the cached rate does not apply

llm.note: called through Vercel AI Gateway's OpenAI-compatible endpoint, pinned to the OpenAI provider (sent as providerOptions.gateway.only = ["openai"]), so both models now use the same gateway, the same key and the same retry policy. The Sep 24-25 passes called api.openai.com directly because the free-tier gateway returned 403 for this model; the owner's gateway account now has paid credits. Vercel lists the same per-token price as OpenAI with no markup, so price_per_million is unchanged. Only the route differs from config.json.
llm.temperature_note: The one setting that differs from config-gateway.json (run 3): temperature 0. GPT-5.4-mini then takes its most likely next token at every step instead of sampling, so it gives its most likely label rather than a sampled one (OpenAI does not guarantee identical output at temperature 0, but variation is rare). Runs 1-3 did not set temperature, so the API default of 1 applied and each label was sampled. Jev has no temperature setting: its Choice answer is the option it gives the highest probability (the choice was the top-probability option on 154 of 154 answers in run 3).
llm.charge_note: Vercel AI Gateway returns each chat completion's generation ID as the response id and its charge in usage.cost (with usage.market_cost). The runner saves both as generation_id and gateway_cost / gateway_market_cost, so the report shows the gateway-reported charge for GPT-5.4-mini as well as for Jev. Runs 1-3 did not save them for GPT-5.4-mini.
